note: a preview on an unmounted volume reports online and a mounted one offline, caught by unmountedIsOffline
a preview with no volume reports offline, caught by noVolumeIsOnline
anchor: guard let volume = entry.volume else { return .online }
replacement: guard let volume = entry.volume else { return .offline(VolumeRef(id: "", name: "")) }

note: volume entries match the whole volume ref, so a renamed volume loses its previews, caught by renamedVolumeMatchesById
